wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/check_markers.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# Proves NO unmerged file still carries a conflict marker, before anything is staged.
# `git status` keeps a resolved file listed as UU until it is added, so it cannot answer this.
cd /Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature || exit 1
left=0
git status --short | grep '^UU' | sed 's/^.. //' | while read -r f; do
  if grep -q '^<<<<<<<\|^>>>>>>>' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'STILL CONFLICTED: %s\n' "$f"
    left=1
  fi
done
echo "scan complete"
